title: 土豆大结局感言
content_zh:
总算是结束了，末了留了一个另外的悬念，萧炎的血是热的，安静的生活，并不适合他的骨子，留下的悬念，就当为了让他有着征战的理由。
当然，关于斗破苍穹的故事，已经结束了。女主的方面，说实在的，我一直是心软的人，舍不得笔下的女子，所以弄了个这般团团圆圆，萧炎的妻子，唯有彩鳞与薰儿，其他，倒更像是红颜知己。
来做一个最后的总结吧。
斗破苍穹，2009年4月14号上传
斗破苍穹，2009年6月1日上架
斗破苍穹，2011年7月20日结束。
历经两年三个月零６天，一共约莫796天，总字数，五百三十一万九千九百零八个字。
两年多，我们一起相随，期间经历过诸多的跌趺撞撞，不过所幸，我们走到了最后。
在这里，再度鞠躬感谢所有一路支持斗破的兄弟姐妹，在这斗破末尾，真诚的说一声，谢谢大家了。
斗破，因为你们，方才炫耀与炫目。
一首斗破主题曲，送予大家，希望我们，能够一直相随相伴，曾经的热血，永存于心。
天才骄，废物恼，休书一纸少年傲

遇药老，重尺扫，心炎锻体情迷渺

师失父丧痛谁知晓
执黑袍，弄火苗，畅游天地任逍遥
成熟中已不再年少
执着信念几番多月前尘飘
苍穹顶峰凄寒催人老
煮酒对饮红颜娇，何妨眸倒
把酒异界天涯海角

两年相伴，心中不舍，只能在此祝所有的读者，心想事成，身体健康。
再次在这里，宣传一下土豆的新书， ，今天也会同步更新，最大的奢望，便是希望新书能够依旧得到大家的喜欢与支持，斗破很辉煌，但土豆会努力，让新书也获得这般成就，真心的拜谢大家了。
{感谢各位书友的支持，您的支持就是我们最大的动力}
content_en:
It is finally over, and there is another suspense left at the end. Xiao Yan's blood is hot, and a quiet life is not suitable for his bones. The suspense left behind is just to give him a reason to fight.
Of course, the story about Fighting to Break the Sky is over. As for the heroine, to be honest, I have always been a soft-hearted person and couldn't bear to leave the women in my novels, so I made it so that Xiao Yan's wives are Cai Lin and Xun'er, and the others are more like confidante.
Let’s make a final summary.
Fight to Break the Sky, uploaded on April 14, 2009
Fight to Break the Sky, released on June 1, 2009
Fighting to Break the Sky ended on July 20, 2011.
It lasted two years, three months and six days, a total of about 796 days, and the total number of words was 5,319,908 words.
We have been together for more than two years, and have experienced many ups and downs during this period, but fortunately, we have made it to the end.
Here, I bow again to thank all the brothers and sisters who have supported Dou Po all the way. At the end of this Dou Po, I sincerely say, thank you all.
Doupo, because of you, I can show off and dazzle.
A Dou Po theme song is given to everyone. I hope that we can always accompany each other, and the passion of the past will always remain in our hearts.

After two years of companionship, I feel reluctant to let go. I can only wish all readers that their dreams come true and good health.
Here again, I would like to promote Tudou's new book, , which will be updated simultaneously today. My biggest hope is that the new book can still get everyone's love and support. The fight is brilliant, but Tudou will work hard to make the new book achieve such success. I sincerely thank you all.
{Thank you all book friends for your support, your support is our biggest motivation}
